format: traditional Cold Stone Creamery restaurant (approx. 1,200 sq ft leased vanilla shell)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Cold Stone Creamery franchise ranges from $390,675 to $680,775 for a traditional restaurant ... This includes $27,300 to $59,300 for a traditional restaurant ... that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") for your first Cold Stone Creamery traditional restaurant is $27,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second and each subsequent traditional restaurant to $15,000.
fee.note: 20% discount for Eligible Military (active, reserve or honorably discharged) and 501(c)(3) organizations: $21,600 first traditional, $12,000 subsequent. Non-traditional $10,000 to $20,000. Grand Opening Marketing fee $10,000 (traditional) also paid to franchisor. Item 7 shows the fee as $12,000 to $27,000. No fee on transfer or renewal.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee and Surcharge (Notes 1 and 13) 6% of Gross Sales plus a maximum Surcharge of $10 per week (Note 2)

adFund.quote: Advertising Fees (Note 1) 3% of weekly Gross Sales ... The Advertising Fees are deposited as follows: 2% to the National Fund and 1% to the Regional Fund for your Cooperative or your store (Note 4).
adFund.note: 3% total (2% National Fund + 1% Regional Fund); may be increased to not exceed 4% of weekly Gross Sales on 30 days' notice.
